divergences.description: Design Notes (spec-7-1) say the 2s poll has no client timeout. The cubit instead gives up after 5 consecutive failed getStatus calls, emitting the generic Erro state and cancelling the timer. The plan's Suggested Review Order records this as a review patch.

The app-wide locale is pinned to pt_BR in main.dart, with the flutter_localizations delegates. This was outside the original spec-7-1 Code Map and tasks; it was added so showDateRangePicker renders in Portuguese. It is recorded in the Review Findings and the Suggested Review Order.
